newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens, Amati agree data pact.
newsitem.headline: Siemens, Amati agree data pact.

text.p: German industrial group Siemens AG said on Tuesday it would work with its Italian Italtel venture and Amati Communications Corp of the United States to increase the speed data can travel over standard phone lines.
The trio expected that ADSL (asymmetric digital subscriber line) technology would enable data to travel over copper wires 200 times faster than is now possible, Siemens said.
ADSL technology would allow computer data to travel over wires without interfering with existing telephone connections, the company said.
Amati, which was formerly ICOT Corp., develops technology for video-on-demand systems.
Italtel is a venture between Siemens and Stet, Italy's state-controlled telecommunications company which is due to be privatised this fall, plans to sell its 50 percent stake in Italtel.
